name: testim-docs-ja
description: Tricentis Testim 公式英語ドキュメントのユーザー制作日本語翻訳
author: rymetry

scripts.lint: npm run lint:md && npm run lint:docs && npm run check:py:static
scripts.lint:md: npm run lint:md:content && npm run lint:md:repo
scripts.lint:py: cd scripts/python && uv run --locked ruff check src tests
scripts.format:py: cd scripts/python && uv run --locked ruff format src tests
scripts.format:py:check: cd scripts/python && uv run --locked ruff format --check src tests
scripts.typecheck:py: cd scripts/python && uv run --locked mypy src
scripts.check:py:static: npm run lint:py && npm run format:py:check && npm run typecheck:py
scripts.test: npm run test:mjs && npm run test:py
scripts.test:py:quick: cd scripts/python && uv run pytest -m 'not corpus and not cutover and not parity_smoke and not recall and not boundary and not real_repo'
scripts.test:py:corpus: cd scripts/python && uv run pytest -m corpus -n auto --dist load --tb=short
scripts.test:py:corpus:regen: cd scripts/python && uv run python -m testim_parity.tools.emit_corpus_oracle --out tests/conformance/__oracle__/corpus_golden.jsonl && uv run python -m testim_parity.tools.summarize_corpus_oracle --in tests/conformance/__oracle__/corpus_golden.jsonl --out tests/conformance/__oracle__/corpus_golden.sha256.tsv
scripts.test:py:corpus:drift: cd scripts/python && uv run python -m testim_parity.tools.summarize_corpus_oracle --in tests/conformance/__oracle__/corpus_golden.jsonl --out .corpus_live.sha256.tsv && diff -q .corpus_live.sha256.tsv tests/conformance/__oracle__/corpus_golden.sha256.tsv
scripts.test:py:parity-smoke: cd scripts/python && uv run pytest -m 'parity_smoke and not cutover' --tb=short
scripts.test:py:quality: cd scripts/python && uv run pytest -m 'recall or boundary or real_repo' --tb=short --durations=30
scripts.test:py:cutover: cd scripts/python && uv run pytest -o addopts= -m cutover
scripts.test:py:full: cd scripts/python && uv run pytest -m 'not cutover'
scripts.test:quick: npm run test:mjs && npm run test:py:quick
scripts.test:all: npm run test:mjs && npm run test:py:full
scripts.test:e2e:build: npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint:docs: cd scripts/python && uv run --locked python -m testim_parity.tools.lint_docs
scripts.check:untranslated: cd scripts/python && uv run python -m testim_parity.detection.find_untranslated
scripts.docs:pipeline: cd scripts/python && uv run python -m testim_parity.pipeline.pipeline
scripts.docs:pipeline:full: cd scripts/python && uv run python -m testim_parity.pipeline.pipeline --mode=full
scripts.docs:pipeline:diff: cd scripts/python && uv run python -m testim_parity.pipeline.pipeline --mode=diff
scripts.docs:fix-alt: cd scripts/python && uv run python -m testim_parity.tools.fix_alt_all
scripts.docs:normalize: cd scripts/python && uv run python -m testim_parity.tools.normalize_docs
scripts.docs:prepare-llm: cd scripts/python && uv run python -m testim_parity.pipeline.prepare_llm_tasks
scripts.check:snapshots:fetch: cd scripts/python && uv run python -m testim_parity.detection.snapshot_update
scripts.check:snapshots:diff: cd scripts/python && uv run python -m testim_parity.detection.snapshot_diff
scripts.check:snapshots: cd scripts/python && uv run python -m testim_parity.detection.snapshot_check
scripts.check:snapshots:fetch:dry-run: cd scripts/python && uv run python -m testim_parity.detection.snapshot_update --dry-run
